lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice common irregular preterite verbs in casual weekend talk.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Two colleagues compare what they ate, drank, saw, and did during the weekend.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Reporting common past actions with high-frequency irregular verbs.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk about a movie, a café visit, and food from the weekend.

main_focus.name: common irregular preterite verbs
main_focus.description: Use frequent irregular past forms in a short, natural recap.
model_examples: Vi åt lunch på ett nytt café.
Jag drack kaffe med en vän.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use common irregular preterite forms naturally 4-6 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: basic modal verbs: kan, vill, ska
one simple reason clause with för att or därför att

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Prioritize common irregular verbs that fit ordinary weekend stories.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks about the weekend or a movie.
dialogue_shape.middle: They share a few past details using irregular preterite forms.
dialogue_shape.ending: They close with a simple opinion or recommendation.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat irregular forms in clear, memorable contexts

focus: the main weekend event or activity
the food or drink detail in the story
the final opinion about the experience

sentence_focus: one sentence with gick or var
one sentence giving a simple past opinion
